text: 从河北廊坊举办的2026中国算力大会了解到，中国算力平台实现全国算力一体化统筹监测，我国算力“一张网、一盘棋、一体化”发展格局基本形成。当前，算力基础设施已成为驱动人工智能发展的关键底座、经济社会高质量发展的重要引擎。工业和信息化部近日印发《信息通信行业发展“十五五”规划》，明确提出加快全国一体化算力网建设，构建“枢纽—区域—边缘”多层次算力设施体系，深化算力自动化监测与供需匹配。（央视）
text_en: It was learned from the 2026 China Computing Power Conference held in Langfang, Hebei, that China's computing power platform has achieved nationwide integrated monitoring of computing power, and the development pattern of "one network, one chessboard, integrated development" for China's computing power has basically taken shape. Currently, computing power infrastructure has become a key foundation driving artificial intelligence development and an important engine for high-quality economic and social development. The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology recently issued the "15th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communications Industry," explicitly proposing to accelerate the construction of a nationwide integrated computing power network, build a multi-level computing power facility system of "hub-region-edge," and deepen automated monitoring of computing power and supply-demand matching. (CCTV)
